कुह् कुह्, cl. 10. A. कुहयते, -यितुम्, to
surprise, astonish; to excite wonder, to cheat,
to deceive by trickery or jugglery, impose upon
(related to गुह्?).

1. कुह, अस्, m. an epithet of Kuvera; a rogue, a
cheat (in अ-कुह, q. v.).

कुह 2. कुह, ind. (fr. 1. कु), Ved. where?
कुह चिद्, wherever, anywhere, somewhere, to any
place.
—कुहचिद्-विद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. being everywhere.

कुहा कुहा, f., N. of a plant, also called
Kaṭukī.
—कुहा-वती, f. an epithet of the goddess
Durgā.
कूहा कूहा, f. a fog, a mist, = कुज्झटिका.

कुहक, अस्, आ, अम्, cheating, a cheat, a rogue, a
juggler; (अस्), m. a frog; N. of a king of the serpent-
race; (अम्, आ), n. f. juggling, deception, sleight-of-
hand, legerdemain.
—कुहक-कार, अस्, ई, अम्, or
कुहक-कारक, अस्, इका, अम्, or कुहक-कारिन्,
ई, इणी, इ, practising jugglery or conjuring, cheating.
—कुहक-चकित, अस्, आ, अम्, afraid of a trick,
suspicious, cautious, wary.
—कुहक-जीविन्, ई, इनी, इ,
living by sleight-of-hand, a conjurer, a cheat, &c.
—कुहक-वृत्ति, इस्, f. juggling, conjuring, sleight-
of-hand; hypocrisy.

कुहन, अस्, आ, अम्, envious, hypocritical; (अस्),
m. a mouse, a rat; a snake; N. of a man; (आ), f.
hypocrisy; assumed and false sanctity; the interested
performance of religious austerities; (अम्), n. a small
earthen vessel; a glass vessel.

कूहना कूहना, f. hypocrisy, affectation of
religious zeal or austerity; [cf. कुहना.]
कुहनिका, f. hypocrisy &c.; [cf. the preceding.]

कुहया, ind., Ved. where?
—कुहया-कृति, इस्,
इस्, इ, Ved. where active?

कुहकस्वन कुहक-स्वन or कुहक-स्वर,
अस्, m. (कुहक being here an onomatopoetic word),
a wild cock, Phasianus Gallus.

कुहरित कुहरित, अम्, n. noise, a sound in
general; especially the song or cry of the Kokila or
Indian cuckoo; a sound uttered in copulation.

कुहारीत कु-हारीत, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), N.
of a man.

कुहलि कुहलि, इस्, m. the leaf of the Piper
Betel (commonly called Pān) with small pieces of
the Areca-nut and Catechu and a little lime, which
are chewed and eaten by the people of the East and
especially offered to the persons present at a matri-
monial ceremony.

कुहु कुहु, उस्, f. the new moon; N. of a
river; the cry of the Kokila; [cf. कुहू.]

कुहू कुहू, ऊस्, f. (fr. कुह् = गुह्?), the new
moon, personified as a daughter of Aṅgiras; the
first day of the first quarter on which the moon rises
invisible; N. of one of the seven rivers of Plaksha-
dvīpa; the cry or song of the Kokila or Indian
cuckoo.
—कुहू-कण्ठ or कुहूक, अस्, m. the
Kokila or Indian cuckoo, κοκκύ
—कुहू-पाल, अस्,
m. the king of turtles, the tortoise supposed to up-
hold the world.
—कुहू-मुख or कुहू-रव, अस्,
m. the Kokila or Indian cuckoo.

कुहुकुहाय कुहुकुहाय (fr. कुहु-कुह for
कुह-कुह, where? where?), nom. A. कुहुकुहा-
यते, to show one's admiration.
कुहूल कुहूल, अम्, n. a pit filled with stakes.

कुहेडिका कुहेडिका or कुहेडी or कुहेलिका, f.
a fog, a mist, haze, haziness.

कुह्वान कु-ह्वान, अम्, n. (see 1. कु), a dis-
agreeable noise.
